title: 杰克·保罗放话：MMA二号平台，拳手报酬能更高？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: All righty we're here to talk about combat sports. I want to hear the energy. I want to see it You know, I want to feel it because that's what all it's all about, right? Always so Jake and Kizu guys
segments.zh: 好了，我们来聊聊格斗运动。我想感受那股能量，想亲眼看到，想亲身体会，因为这才是关键，对吧？一直都是这样。杰克和基祖，两位好。

segments.en: We're just here recently feels like it was just a couple of weeks ago to talk about the recent merger between MVP and PFL Jake what's been the reception in the combat sports community?
segments.zh: 我们最近刚来过，感觉就像几周前，聊了MVP和PFL的合并。杰克，格斗圈的反响怎么样？

segments.en: It's been good, you know And I think people realize the power and the company that we've created and the importance of
segments.zh: 反响很好。我觉得人们意识到了我们创造的公司力量，以及重要性。

segments.en: Having a number two entity on the MMA side where other fighters can go to and get just as big of paydays if not more and
segments.zh: 在MMA领域有第二大平台，让其他拳手也能去，拿到同样甚至更高的报酬。

segments.en: the same amount of attention if not more and so really It's the thesis of our whole organization which is fighter first and
segments.zh: 获得同样甚至更多的关注。这就是我们整个组织的理念：拳手优先。

segments.en: the reception of all the fighters wanting to do something with us the excitement behind it and And
segments.zh: 所有拳手都想和我们合作，那种兴奋感，以及……

segments.en: There's never been a boxing and MMA entity that's all under the same roof vertically integrated So you feel like people got that vision get the vision of having them under one roof together. I
segments.zh: 从来没有一个拳击和MMA实体能垂直整合在同一屋檐下。所以你觉得人们理解了那个愿景，把两者放在一起。

segments.en: Think they'll understand it more as time goes on And I think it's mainly because of like the brandy and element of it and what we're gonna be calling each sides of it, but
segments.zh: 随着时间推移，他们会更理解。我认为这主要是因为品牌元素，以及我们怎么称呼双方，但……

segments.en: Yeah, there's a ton of excitement around it because for so long the fans have wanted to see certain fights that don't get made because
segments.zh: 是的，有很多兴奋感，因为长期以来粉丝们想看的某些比赛没能举办，因为……
